crossRefs.note: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so…
If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.
All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.
They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it…
For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience…
who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent…
Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from…
For I have heard the defaming of many, “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar…
As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in…

translations.web: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.
translations.bsb: Then the Pharisees went out and conspired to trap Jesus in His words.
translations.kjv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
translations.asv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might ensnare him in his talk.
